# Cornerstone Builder Software (Cornerstone PM)

> Construction project management SaaS for residential home builders. Combines scheduling, purchasing, design center, sales, and pricing into one platform with AI agents that handle the busywork.

Website: https://cornerstonepm.ai
Contact: admin@cornerstonepm.ai
Status: Public beta (2026)
Pricing: $149/mo (Starter) – $599/mo (Enterprise) per builder, includes unlimited subcontractor and buyer logins.

## What it is

Cornerstone PM is an end-to-end home builder management platform built specifically for small and mid-sized residential home builders (1–500 homes/year). It replaces the typical stack of spreadsheets, BuilderTrend/CoConstruct, separate CRM tools, design center binders, and email-driven vendor coordination with a single integrated system.

Unlike auction-style platforms that push lowest-bid vendor selection, Cornerstone respects each builder's existing community-vendor relationships: builders assign which vendors get to bid per community, and pricing flows automatically from accepted bids into scope items, budgets, and buyer-facing pricing.

## Core modules

- **Construction Scheduling** — Gantt charts, drag-and-drop dependencies, cascade notifications when tasks shift, vendor schedule visibility, customer portal updates.
- **Purchasing & Vendor Bidding** — One-click bid-to-all-vendors per scope, side-by-side bid comparison, lock-after-acceptance protection, multiple accepted bids per scope (one vendor in Community A, different in Community B), token-protected vendor portal (no login required for subs).
- **Design Center** — Per-floorplan design options manager, 64 curated Designer Packages across 7 categories, à la carte unlock when packages are removed, buyer-facing selection portal.
- **Sales & Pricing** — 60-second home sale flow, pricing matrix by community/floorplan/lot, auto-budget on sale, MLS listing description generation, sales pipeline.
- **Permitting** — Permit tracking pipeline tied to construction schedule milestones.
- **Area Cost Pricing** — Community-level extras with full takeoff integration.
- **Buyer Portal** — Selections, change orders, schedule visibility, document delivery.
- **AI Agents** — Foreman (47 skills, scheduling/vendor coordination), Blueprint AI (takeoff/material), plus role-specific assistants for sales, purchasing, design, and permitting.

## Differentiators (vs BuilderTrend, CoConstruct, Buildxact, spreadsheets)

- **Community-assigned vendor wins, not lowest bid.** Builders pick which vendors get to bid per community; the platform respects existing relationships.
- **Lock-after-acceptance.** Once a bid is awarded, neither builder nor vendor can edit it — protects awarded pricing from drift.
- **No filler/default pricing.** Every dollar shown to a buyer or builder traces back to actual vendor pricing. Material breakdown comes from real takeoff parts; labor from accepted vendor bids. No synthetic splits, no estimator fudging.
- **Scope items, not rigid material/labor splits.** Scope items are flexible buckets (labor, material, lump sum, mixed) that match how builders actually buy work.
- **Vendor self-serve portal.** Token-protected, no login required. Vendors edit pending bids themselves.
- **AI-native.** Foreman has 47 skills; Blueprint handles material takeoff; assistants surface in every module.
- **Designer Packages.** 64 curated design packages — pick one and category options auto-lock to it. Strong differentiator vs spreadsheet-style design centers.

## Target customer

- Residential home builders building 1–500 homes/year
- Production builders, semi-custom builders, custom builders
- US-based (current focus); global rollout planned
- Pain points solved: spreadsheet sprawl, vendor email chaos, design center binders, change-order tracking, schedule slippage, pricing drift, buyer communication.

## Pricing tiers

- **Starter** — $149/mo. Up to 25 active homes, all modules, unlimited vendors, unlimited buyers.
- **Growth** — $299/mo. Up to 100 active homes, full AI agents, advanced reporting.
- **Pro** — $449/mo. Up to 250 active homes, multi-community, API access.
- **Enterprise** — $599/mo. Unlimited homes, white-label buyer portal, dedicated support, custom integrations.

All tiers include unlimited subcontractor and buyer logins.

## Founder

Scott Buescher — third-generation home builder, software engineer. Built Cornerstone PM after 15 years running production home building operations and watching every existing tool fall short of what builders actually need.
